usage: expertflow [-h]
                  {inspect,compile,validate,explain,stock,baseline,collect-pairs,doctor,profile,parity,recommend,replay,simulate,prefetch-sim,transfer-benchmark,transfer-aggregate,mover-benchmark,capacity-curve,heldout-curve,heldout-breakdown,deadline-eval,optimize,run,serve,compare,demo}
                  ...

Profile and explain sparse-MoE routing on local hardware.

positional arguments:
  {inspect,compile,validate,explain,stock,baseline,collect-pairs,doctor,profile,parity,recommend,replay,simulate,prefetch-sim,transfer-benchmark,transfer-aggregate,mover-benchmark,capacity-curve,heldout-curve,heldout-breakdown,deadline-eval,optimize,run,serve,compare,demo}
    inspect             Normalize supported GGUF metadata into ModelIR.
    compile             Compile, confirm and replay a measured exact execution
                        plan.
    validate            Verify a sealed plan, evidence and live identities.
    explain             Export decisions without promoting estimates to
                        measurements.
    stock               Generate, collect or validate registered stock
                        workflows.
    baseline            Run and measure an unmodified llama.cpp baseline.
    collect-pairs       Collect resumable tracing-disabled/tracing-enabled
                        prompt pairs.
    doctor              Record hardware, storage, and toolchain readiness.
    profile             Create a measured locality profile from a router
                        trace.
    parity              Compare deterministic token sequences with and without
                        tracing.
    recommend           Create an evidence-bounded machine-specific
                        recommendation.
    replay              Render a standalone causal policy replay report.
    simulate            Compare estimated cache policies over a router trace.
    prefetch-sim        Estimate bounded next-step prefetch over interleaved
                        traces.
    transfer-benchmark  Measure CUDA host-to-device transfer latency.
    transfer-aggregate  Pool raw CUDA transfer samples from independent
                        trials.
    mover-benchmark     Measure contiguous batching, queue depth, and ready
                        latency.
    capacity-curve      Estimate cache policy curves over one or more router
                        traces.
    heldout-curve       Fit static residents on training traces and score
                        held-out traces.
    heldout-breakdown   Report held-out policy results by conversation and
                        domain.
    deadline-eval       Evaluate a backend-specific oracle one-layer transfer
                        bound.
    optimize            Create a measured deployment manifest.
    run                 Launch inference from a deployment manifest.
    serve               Launch an OpenAI-compatible llama-server deployment.
    compare             Compare stock and ExpertFlow recorded evidence.
    demo                Replay the committed product evidence.
